Package com.nexuslink.protocol.db

Class UserDriver

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.db.UserDriver
public final class UserDriver extends Object
A JDBC driver the user added themselves by pointing at a jar on disk — the escape hatch for databases NexusLink doesn't know about, and for organisations whose approved driver build is only available from an internal share.

Mutable with a no-arg constructor because it is persisted as JSON by UserDriverStore, matching the on-disk model used elsewhere in the app.

  • Method Details

    • toDriverInfo

      public DriverInfo toDriverInfo()
      Adapts this to the catalog's DriverInfo shape so user drivers appear in the same list as the built-in ones. Never bundled, and it has no Maven coordinates — the jar is already on disk, so there is nothing to download.
